description: Two cute cartoon bunnies warmly hugging with a pink heart above them, radiating sweetness and affectionate comfort. It is perfect for sending virtual hugs, showing deep love or care, and comforting friends or partners in friendly, emotional chats.

A sleek app icon featuring the white Telegram paper airplane logo centered on a bright blue rounded square. It conveys a clean, social-media-focused vibe, making it ideal for sharing Telegram handles, linking to channels, or referencing messaging and chats.

A classic yellow raised hand shown with an open palm facing forward. It works well for signaling "stop," asking someone to pause or wait, raising your hand to volunteer or speak up, or offering a virtual high five.

A derpy, chibi anime catgirl with wide blank eyes sticking her tongue out in a silly, brain-empty expression. Ideal for conveying playful silliness, teasing friends, or reacting with goofy, unbothered vibes.
